verdict.rationale: RudderStack documents several APIs (HTTP API, Pixel API, Event Audit API, management APIs), so a downloadable spec is a fair question for this product, but the evidence shows no OpenAPI or equivalent file to download. A probe of common OpenAPI and Swagger paths returned 404 on every candidate. The llms.txt file and the MCP server are adjacent AI-facing features, not a machine-readable API spec, so they earn no credit here.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can download a machine-readable API spec (OpenAPI or equivalent)
